name: Cable Anti-Rotation Lift and Chop
description: A combined cable movement pairing a low-to-high lift with a high-to-low chop through the frontal plane. The anti-rotation demand comes from resisting the cable's rotational pull throughout the full arc. This integrates oblique and transverse abdominis function in sport-specific patterns.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Cable Anti-Rotation Lift and Chop in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Cable Anti-Rotation Lift and Chop.
steps: Step 1: Stand sideways to low cable. Grip handle with both hands at hip level.
Step 2: Rotate and lift cable diagonally across body to high opposite position.
Step 3: Reverse the motion, chopping back down to starting position.
Step 4: Complete reps on one side then switch.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Using momentum instead of muscular control
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Move from your core, not your arms
